Senna|sup.identity: Physical damage, utility marksman support. Absolution (passive): units that die near her sometimes leave a soul; by attacking it, she collects Mist that permanently increases her attack damage, range and crit chance. Her attacks are slow but powerful. Piercing Darkness (Q) fires a beam that heals allies and damages enemies, Last Embrace (W) roots the target and nearby enemies after a short delay, Curse of the Black Mist (E) camouflages Senna and the allies in its area, and Dawning Shadow (R) fires a beam with unlimited range that shields allies hit and damages enemies in the center.
Senna|sup.playstyle: Poke and scaling support: she harasses from long range, heals with Q and becomes a real threat thanks to souls. No clearly unfavorable matchups: her worst ones (Blitzcrank, Zyra, Thresh) stay close to even. She crushes melee supports and slow mages (Swain, Pantheon, Brand, Poppy).
Senna|sup.early_game: Harass your opponent with your long-range attacks and Q (through a minion or your ADC, it also heals). Pick up the souls that appear: each one makes you permanently stronger. Keep W to stop an engage or start a kill.
Senna|sup.level_1: Piercing Darkness (Q) first. After that, max Q first.
Senna|sup.level_2: Last Embrace (W). A delayed CC: combo with your ADC, or defense against a diver.
Senna|sup.level_3: Curse of the Black Mist (E). Camouflage to escape, reposition your duo, or surprise your opponents.
Senna|sup.level_6: Dawning Shadow: a global beam that shields allies hit and damages enemies in the center. Save an ally in another lane or finish a fleeing enemy.
power_spikes: Collected souls: increasing range and damage.
Late game: very long attack range.
Senna|sup.lane_plan: Harass with your attacks and Q, collect souls and protect your ADC. Stay in the bot lane until level 5: since patch 26.16, your minion gold and XP are cut by a third elsewhere. The support role quest then makes your Control Wards cheaper (40 gold, two stored). Use your ultimate to help the other lanes.
Senna|sup.trading: Basic trade: attack, Q through a minion. All-in: W, Q, attacks. Defense: W on the engage, E to camouflage your duo. Against hooks (Blitzcrank, Thresh), stay behind minions: you're fragile.
threats: Blitzcrank, Thresh and Zyra: your worst matchups, close to even.
Hooks and engages that catch you: you're fragile.
Assassins who target you in teamfights.
mistakes: Standing in the open against a hook.
Wasting your ultimate with no ally to shield and no enemy to finish.

matchup_notes.Thresh: Stay behind minions and keep W for his engage.
matchup_notes.Lulu: Poke trades: your range is longer.
matchup_notes.Nautilus: His anchor doesn't get through minions: stay behind them.
matchup_notes.Nami: Dodge her bubble and harass her from farther away.
matchup_notes.Swain: He has to get close: poke him from range.

Senna|sup.mid_game: Collect souls, place Control Wards and poke before objectives. Protect your team with R.
Senna|sup.late_game: Hit from your very long range behind your frontline. W on divers, E to reposition the team, R at the start of the fight to protect.
Senna|sup.ahead: Poke and collect souls: you become a damage threat.
Senna|sup.behind: Play utility: Q, W, E and R stay decisive even without a lead.
Senna|sup.win_condition: To win this game, you want to harass from long range, collect souls and protect your team with your global ultimate.
Senna|sup.final_tip: Your Q heals allies it passes through: aim at your opponent through your ADC to heal and damage at the same time.
